definitions.supplemental: from lútan, as bígan from búgan
definitions.meaning: to cause to bow, to bend, incline

quotations.old_english: Ðæt ingeþonc ǽlces monnes ðone líchoman lít ðider hit wile
quotations.english: the mind of every man inclines the body whither it will

source_text: lítan [from lútan, as bígan from búgan] to cause to bow, to bend, incline :-- Ðæt ingeþonc ǽlces monnes ðone líchoman lít ðider hit wile the mind of every man inclines the body whither it will, Bt. Met. Fox 26, 237; Met. 26, 119.
